name: @stonedogcode/tests-server
description: The standalone test-inventory server: the fleet table running against the committed fixtures, with no private data and no credentials.
//private: Never published. It is part of the repository so the package can be seen working; it is not part of the package, whose `files` list ships src/ alone.
//scripts: No `build`. The fixture reading lives in a dev-server middleware, so a static build would produce a site whose own /api/inventories 404s — a broken artefact that looks like a working one. `type-check` covers compilation.
//dependencies: stonedog-logs lives HERE and not in the library. The library is zero-dependency by design; a logger is only wanted by a process that actually runs, and imposing one on every consumer of a React table would be the opposite of the point.
